notes.title: Spanish localization available now!
notes.notes:
Great news! Fatal Falls now has a Spanish localization! 🎉 However, please note that AI-assisted translation was used, so some parts may not be perfect. If you spot any issues, feel free to let me know!

I'm also working on other translations, so stay tuned for more language options in the future! 🌍

Thank you for your support!

notes.title: QoL update
notes.notes:
- The in-game language is now always dependent on the language set in Steam (cf. Properties > General > Language)
- Optimized the UI in various places, most notably the pause and main menu
- Improved the stability in chapter 1

notes.title: Small Bugfix
notes.notes: Fixed incorrect actor names and lines in the Leonard&Sophia dialogue in the 'Death' ending.

notes.title: Quality of Life Update
notes.notes:
– Added animated dialogue text (typewriter effect)
– Replaced the option "Dialogue autoplay" with "Animated dialogue text" (activated by default)
– Bugfix: The character models of the police officer and protagonist in the interrogation remain T-posed in the mirror on low quality settings
– Bugfix: Wrong mention of Schubert's F minor fantasy in the credits
– Bugfix: Wrong LOD groups in chapter 2
– Bugfix: The "Secrets" track sometimes still plays after the receptionist spawns in chapter 2
– Note: I am aware of the performance issues in chapter 2 on the Ultra and Very High quality settings. It will be fixed in the next major update

notes.title: A 100% walkthrough is available now
notes.notes:
Hey everyone,

Several puzzles and moments have proven particularly challenging for some players. Therefore, I've written a detailed walkthrough for the game:

[url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3370023689]https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3370023689[/url]

It's recommended to only use this guide when you are completely stuck.

Have fun!

– Tripolar Studio

notes.title: Please review the game!
notes.notes:
Hey, everyone! 👋

First of all, THANK YOU for playing Fatal Falls!

If you’ve enjoyed the game (or even if you didn’t), I'd really appreciate it if you could take a moment to leave a review on Steam. Reviews help more than you might think — they boost the game in Steam’s algorithm, making it easier for others to discover and join the adventure.

I truly value honest feedback, so don’t hold back! Whether it’s praise, suggestions, or critical feedback, your voice helps me improve and grow as developer.

Your review could be the nudge someone needs to give the game a try. 🌟

Thank you for helping!

— Tripolar Studio

notes.title: Steam Cloud support
notes.notes:
Added Steam Cloud support.

Here’s what it means:
✅ Seamless Save Syncing: Your save files are now automatically backed up in the Steam Cloud.
✅ Cross-Device Play: Switch between devices and pick up right where you left off—your progress stays with you!
✅ No More Lost Saves: Even if you reinstall the game, your saved states will be ready and waiting.

Thank you for your continued support.

— Tripolar Studio

notes.notes:
